files.what: Building-level census: one row per data-center building (US + Canada), 77 fields: stage, power (published, Aterio estimate, selected, critical IT), dates, provider, tenants, utility, balancing authority, cost, links, notes.

Event log: one row per building per milestone (announced, construction started, 5-95% progress reads from satellite, finished, active, delayed, withdrawn, cancelled). Joins to the inventory on ATERIO_DATA_CENTER_UID.
Month-end point-in-time copies of the inventory and events (same schema). They show what Aterio knew at each date, so comparing them reveals stage moves, date slips and coverage added.
Quarter-end subset of the monthly history (byte-identical copies of the matching month-ends). Nothing new; kept for convenience.
Field guide for the inventory and events files: type, building vs campus level, description, example.

files.what: Aterio's own Excel report: 30-day deltas by stage, a cumulative activation forecast (optimistic / baseline / conservative) by state, ISO, provider and utility, a monthly momentum series rebuilt with today's knowledge, ISO demand vs DC capacity, cancellations, conversion and days-to-start tables, generator demand.
Behind-the-meter / dedicated generation for data centers: one row per plant phase (project > plant > phase), technology, fuel, nameplate MW, stage, developer, customer, equipment suppliers, dates.
The inventory rows (same 77 fields) of the data centers linked to a BTM generation project (join on ATERIO_POWER_GENERATION_PROJECT_UID).

takeaways: 71.5 GW of facility power is under construction across 821 buildings (≈62 GW IT-equivalent). Aterio dates 13.1 GW of it to 2026, 27.0 GW to 2027 and 26.8 GW to 2028.
The announced pipeline (383 GW) is 5.3× what is being built. Aterio rates 44% of it high-likelihood. Its own forecast puts 200 GW cumulative online by end-2028 (baseline), against 52 GW active today.
Part of the growth is coverage, not new projects. Since 2025-08-31 the census added 3,330 buildings / 308 GW. 78 GW of that was announced before 2025-08-31, so it was backfilled.

Dates slip. Of the 22.3 GW that was under construction on 2025-08-31 and dated after it, 88% (MW-weighted) now carries a later activation date. The median slip is 9 months. Of the 15.2 GW that was due to go live by 2026-08-31, 3.9 GW is active.
Construction is concentrated. TX, VA, GA hold 42% of construction GW. Hyperscaler self-builds (AMZN, GOOG, META, MSFT, ORCL, AAPL as provider) are 38% of it.
Onsite power is a gas story. 195 GW of behind-the-meter generation phases are tracked, 79% natural gas, but only 38 GW is active or under construction. 1,069 data-center buildings link to one.
